card.name: The word with after patients
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "patients" in contraindication or population statements. Also fires on "with" or "the" before a following condition or diluent in dosing and preparation text.

modes.label: With after patients
modes.description: The word "with" follows "patients" and introduces a condition or hypersensitivity.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS VEKLURY is contraindicated in patients<< with>> a history of clinically significant hypersensitivity reactions

modes.label: Preparation wording
modes.description: A linking word in dilution or inspection instructions, such as "with" before a diluent or "the" after "whenever".
modes.example: Dilute the withdrawn VYVGART with<< >>0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection

card.writes: It pushes down report-related words, with no strong promoted theme.
card.plain: It fires on the small word "with" in phrases like "contraindicated in patients with" that lead into a condition.
